title: SwitchMLP router weights not synchronized within TP group
root_cause: torch.nn.Linear in router uses default CUDA RNG which has different seeds across TP ranks. Router weights diverge from initialization.
invariant: router.weight checksum must be identical across all ranks in the same TP group
fixed_behavior: training completes with consistent router weights across TP ranks
notes: Old Megatron version — does not support --mock-data, requires fake preprocessed data
failure_reason: default CUDA RNG synced across TP ranks
